qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Post-LXi merger UK triple-net lease and urban logistics portfolio; 5-year median ROIC of 5.1% fails the 12% hurdle, and RPI/CPI escalators are predominantly capped at 3.5-4.0%, lagging inflation shocks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 5.1%, REJECT). Well-managed UK NNN and urban logistics aggregator fails capital efficiency hurdle with 5-year median ROIC of 5.1%. RPI/CPI escalators capped at 3.5-4.0% lag inflation surges, while high leverage (debt/NI > 9x) exposes cash flow to refinancing headwinds.
qualitative.evidence: LondonMetric holds a £6.2B commercial real estate portfolio post-LXi merger, focusing on urban logistics (40%+), long income convenience retail, and entertainment. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 5.07% (FY25: 6.49%, FY24: 7.96%, FY23: 3.65%, FY22: -13.08%), failing the 12% hurdle. Net debt stands at ~£2.76B with debt/net income of 9.6x and interest coverage of 3.2x (EBIT £432.1M / Interest £135.0M). Contractual lease escalators are capped at 3.5-4.0%, failing to maintain purchasing power during high-inflation cycles.
